svg.title: Freight forwarder — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as freight forwarder, wearing a collared shirt. Visible work cue: A long horizontal ribbed shipping container sits below a separate shipment manifest with two entry lines. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: short curls, a tapered face.
